title: ORC and MCM2-7 ChIP-exo in G1 and G2 arrest (Reuter et al. 2024), as deposited on sacCer3
measurement: Orc2 and Mcm4 occupancy by ChIP-exo
scale: combined tracks: CPM with reads extended to ~209 bp, genome-wide mean 17.1 in every sample; strand tracks: coverage per million mapped reads at the 50 bp read length, about 4.2x lower in height for that reason

source.citation: Reuter LM, Khadayate SP, Mossler A, Liebl K, Faull SV, Karimi MM, Speck C. MCM2-7 loading-dependent ORC release ensures genome-wide origin licensing. Nat Commun 15:7306 (2024)
samples_used: GSM5269283 (Mcm4-Flag ChIP-Exo from cells arrested in G1, rep1)
GSM5269284 (Mcm4-Flag ChIP-Exo from cells arrested in G1, rep2)
GSM5269285 (Orc2-Flag ChIP-Exo from cells arrested in G1, rep1)
GSM5269286 (Orc2-Flag ChIP-Exo from cells arrested in G1, rep2)
GSM5269287 (Orc2-Flag ChIP-Exo from cells arrested in G2, rep1)
GSM5269288 (Orc2-Flag ChIP-Exo from cells arrested in G2, rep2)
samples_excluded: GSE240472 subseries (Orc2 ChIP-exo 24 min after G1 release)
ChExMix peak calls deposited beside each bigWig
source.exclusion_reason: the hub carries the G1 and G2 arrest conditions; the release time course and the per-replicate peak calls were not requested and the peak calls are unfiltered

submitter_processing: Bowtie2 v2.3.5 to sacCer3, 50 bp single-end reads, Illumina HiSeq 2500
deepTools v3.2.1 bigWig generation, --normalizeUsing CPM (combined tracks only)
provenance.validation: all 18 deposited bigWigs carry exactly the 17 sequences of sacCer3.chrom.sizes at identical lengths, so no renaming or lift was needed; combined tracks were copied byte-for-byte and their sha256 of the deposited file is recorded per sample

replicate_correlation.statistic: Pearson r between replicates, combined tracks, base resolution, whole genome

provenance.caveat: the deposited combined track is not the sum of the deposited strand pair (r = 0.83-0.86 between them): the combined track extends reads to ~209 bp while the strand tracks keep the 50 bp read footprint, so the combined track is the smoother of the two views of the same reads

samples.title: Mcm4-Flag ChIP-Exo from cells arrested in G1, rep1
samples.strand_transformation: raw read coverage multiplied by 0.273872 = 1e6 / 3651345 mapped reads (both strands, from sum|coverage|/50); divide by this factor to recover the deposited integers
